Scanning for junk…
Everything moves to the Windows Recycle Bin — restore anything you miss. Files younger than 24h (7 days for reports) are kept, locked files are skipped, and cookies, passwords, and history are never touched.

Winget Updates

Upgrade installed applications through the Windows Package Manager. Updates run with winget upgrade --id … --exact --silent; winget shows any UAC prompts it needs.

Available upgradesChecking…
0 selected
Package Installed Available Source Action
Checking for updates…
Updates run through the official winget CLI with vendor-signed installers. Only packages from the last scan can be updated, WinBGM never updates itself from inside the app, and every update is recorded in Change history.

Settings

Appearance, display preferences, text readability, and administrator privileges.

Appearance & PersonalizationTheme & colors
App theme
Choose between Dark, Light, AMOLED pitch black, or sync automatically with your Windows system preference.
Accent color
Customize the highlight color used across buttons, indicators, active tabs, and navigation items.
Display & Readability
Text size & UI scale
Scale up the text and interface elements for easier reading. You can also press Ctrl + and Ctrl - anytime to zoom.
Show Windows and Microsoft system components
Includes Windows' own services and system packages. Hidden by default to keep the list focused on your apps.
Privileges & Startup
Always start as administrator
Windows will prompt for administrator rights automatically whenever WinBGM is launched, giving you full process inspection and access to reconfigure services and tasks.
Minimize to System Tray on close (Watchdog Daemon)
Keep WinBGM running quietly in the Windows notification tray so the Persistence Watchdog can alert you via Windows Toast notifications if an installer adds a startup entry.
Safety & GuardrailsAlways active
Windows System Restore Point
Create a native Windows System Restore checkpoint before making major service, task, or uninstall changes for maximum peace of mind.
Backup before every change
The original setting is saved to Change history first. If the backup can't be saved, nothing is changed.
Protect Windows and security software
Windows' own components, critical services and antivirus can't be changed from here.
